events.title: Jennifer Lopez turns 57
events.blurb: Global superstar Jennifer Lopez celebrates her 57th birthday today.

angles.name: J.Lo's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Happy 57th birthday to the one and only J.Lo! From the Bronx to global icon, her influence on music, film, and fashion is undeniable.

events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Icon
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Happy birthday to the incomparable Mick Jagger, a true rock and roll icon.

events.title: MTV launched in 1981
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched on this day in 1981, famously opening with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'.

angles.name: The Day Music Changed
angles.copy: Remember when music TV changed everything? On this day in 1981, MTV launched, and the first video played was 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles. How ironic.

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe in 1994
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, marking a pivotal moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Britpop Masterpiece
angles.copy: 22 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. Still sounds as fresh and anthemic now as it did then. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival took place in 1969
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a three-day festival of peace and music, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Three Days of Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. Happy anniversary to the iconic Woodstock Festival.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King. On this day in 1977, we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legacy continue to shake, rattle, and roll generations.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a true legend. On this day in 1996, the world lost Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and enduring influence on hip-hop continue to resonate.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away; he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the master. On this day in 1970, we lost Jimi Hendrix, a visionary who redefined what was possible with a guitar. His music still electrifies.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road in 1969
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969, featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs – a timeless masterpiece. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend, still delivering those iconic Pretenders hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon released Imagine in 1975
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod in 2001
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember this? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the first iPod. Suddenly, thousands of songs in your pocket was a reality. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy 007 Day!
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to thrilling gadgets, what's your favourite Bond film or moment? License to thrill, indeed.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album' in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your go-to track from it?
